1.consolidated_definition: Notación informativa que hace el juez de inscripción sobre cada uno de los gallos que se postulan para combatir el día de la pelea: sus dueños o representantes, pero, cualidades físicas, tipo de espuelas convenidas, postas, etc. el examen del juez de inscripción revela si un gallo es apto o no para la lidia. Su informe para al juez de valla, quien lo da a conocer al público.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Inscribing notation that the registrar judge makes on each of the roosters that are postulating to fight on the day of the fight: their owners or representatives, but also physical qualities, type of agreed spurs, posts, etc. The registrar judge's examination reveals whether a rooster is fit or not for cockfighting. His report is for the gate judge, who makes it known to the public.
